notes: Pinky on Robinhood Chain (4663), paired with IMD. LaunchToken has no constructor arguments. PinkyStaking(stakingToken = $token, rewardToken = IMD) has no owner. PinkyVault arguments, in order: owner ($owner), IMD, PinkyStaking, Intake, bytes32("oracle.request@oracle-1"), oracle signer (the attester reported by https://api.imd.fun/oracle/requests on 2026-10-09), minimum bond 5 IMD, panel size 7, quorum 5, validity 86400 seconds. The owner may change the Intake, the action id, the signer and the panel settings; IMD, PinkyStaking and the minimum bond are immutable. No initialization calls.
